primary_hypothesis.label: static_preview_soft_rank_admits_progress_toward_backup_support_trap
primary_hypothesis.statement: Backup-only eligibility permits a moving action whose full preview fails the unchanged geometric margin to win on route progress. Guide-following and physical tracking then enter an upper-wall pose where delayed braking checks reject most/all available forward-only actions. The trace supports this mechanism; no paired intervention establishes causality or separates tracking, rank, guide curvature and timing contributions.
direct_support: All88 recorded dynamic counts are0, so dynamic occupancy expansion is absent in these decisions.
19 selected moving actions have negative full preview;16 produce a nonzero first control,3 have a nonnegative-preview moving alternative within the existing backup mask.
The first empty mask at11.008s has safe instantaneous geometric state but invalid hold+brake trajectories.
Later actual pose approaches upper raster wall with large heading error;backup margin approaches and crosses0.
alternative_or_mediating_factors: The shared A* guide has heading kinks and no Ackermann feasibility qualification.
Fixed pure-pursuit lookahead0.7m and actual physical steering/velocity lag may contribute; no counterfactual was replayed.
15 measured transaction deadline zeros may perturb trajectory; counts do not estimate their causal effect.
All-steering/tilt hull,0.33m margin,raster outward rounding and delayed-braking motion deduction are conservative assumptions, not observed physical collision.
Eight forward/stop actions supply no reverse recovery or independent steering-at-rest control.

proposed_single_factor.name: analytic_static_full_preview_selection_eligibility_v1
proposed_single_factor.changes: Analytic selection eligibility only; preserve original observation action_mask as backup-valid mask and expose separate selection_eligibility.
proposed_single_factor.stop_policy: Retain backup_stop eligibility/command-time revalidation. Select highest unchanged prior among eligible actions including original stop if backup-valid; if none, output existing fail-closed stop.
proposed_single_factor.full_preview_value: Use the existing recorded candidate feature candidates[a,3] >=0; positive normalizer3 preserves sign and all tested values are far from float32 underflow. No rerollout or changed prediction model.
proposed_single_factor.not_combined_with: M08 tracking/occupancy factor or actor training
proposed_single_factor.hypothesis: Fewer negative-preview moving selections before upper-wall approach may preserve future backup support.
falsifiers: Early eligible moving support remains empty despite clear observed state.
The new selector stops earlier and still times out.
Physical tracking/guide curvature causes the same upper-wall support collapse despite nonnegative selected previews.
proposed_single_factor.future_evidence: Separately reviewed fresh paired development runs, identical factor-free inputs/budgets, failure-inclusive outcomes; no claim that the3 logged alternatives would succeed.

M08_implication: M08 inherits step/rollout and the same prior/backup-only eligibility. Extra tracks cannot repair this static action-support mechanism by themselves. Do not train before measuring usable execution support.
limitations: Feature float32 rounding makes reconstructed scores approximate; all88 chosen IDs nevertheless match.
Trace command counts are not independent time fractions or causal effects.
Terminal endpoint poses are observed actual initial preview states, not a replay or simulator truth from a new run.
R2 and TEB success demonstrate world traversability, not exact same guide-consumer semantics or a feasible frozen8-candidate policy.
No current source, margin, stop protocol or selection was changed.
Six geometric pose checks are not full trajectory replay or actual articulated compound clearance.
R2/actualTEB success establishes scene traversability under their consumers, not route-core policy feasibility.
The declared source deadline at29.460s is the outcome authority; a later local episode_time_limit trace is diagnostic.
